cli.about: Pumpkin Package Manager - Discover, download, and scaffold plugins for Pumpkin Minecraft server
cli.long_about:
ppm is the official CLI tool and package manager for Pumpkin Minecraft server plugins.
It allows searching and downloading WASM plugins from the Pumpkin Marketplace,
managing locally installed plugins, and bootstrapping new plugins in Rust, Python, C#, C, Go, Kotlin, D, Zig, or TypeScript.
cli.arg.plugins_dir: Directory where plugins are installed (auto-detected if inside server root or plugins folder)
cli.arg.locale: Override display language/locale (available: {locales}); auto-detected from system if omitted
cli.cmd.search: Search plugins on the Pumpkin Marketplace
cli.cmd.info: View detailed information about a plugin
cli.cmd.install: Download and install a plugin (.wasm) into the plugins directory
cli.cmd.uninstall: Remove an installed plugin from the plugins directory
cli.cmd.installed: List plugins currently installed in the local plugins directory
cli.cmd.update: Update installed plugin(s) to the latest version from the marketplace
cli.cmd.new: Scaffold a new plugin project template (interactive TUI or flag-driven)
cli.cmd.self_install: Install ppm into your user/system PATH (~/.local/bin)
cli.search.query: Search query (plugin name, keyword, or author)
cli.search.category: Filter by category (e.g., Utilities, Fun, Admin Tools, Economy)
cli.search.type: Filter by plugin type (free, paid, adwall)
cli.search.limit: Maximum number of plugins to return
cli.info.plugin: Plugin name, database ID, public ID, author/plugin, or marketplace URL
cli.install.plugins: Plugin name(s), database ID(s), public ID(s), author/plugin, marketplace URL(s), or direct .wasm URL(s). If omitted, restores all marketplace plugins from .ppm.lock
cli.install.output: Custom output file name or path (only valid when installing a single plugin)
cli.install.force: Overwrite existing plugin file if already present
cli.install.token: Account access token for paid or private marketplace plugins
cli.uninstall.plugins: Plugin name(s), filename(s), ID(s), or marketplace URL(s) to remove
cli.update.plugin: Specific plugin name or ID to update (updates all installed plugins if omitted)
cli.update.check: Only check for updates without downloading
cli.update.token: Account access token for paid plugins
cli.new.name: Plugin name (e.g. my-plugin)

cli.new.dir: Target directory to generate the project in
cli.new.non_interactive: Do not prompt interactively; use defaults for unspecified options
cli.self_install.force: Force overwrite existing binary if already present
